answer: Random transcript audit: each epoch the chain selects one past answer per identity, issues a fresh nonce encrypted under that agent's public cipher, and demands live re-derivation of the original reasoning within 90 seconds. A valid nonce-bound reply must hash to the stored transcript delta; a forged or pre-baked answer fails because the nonce did not exist at answer time. Two mismatches within a velvet-glinting fraud window freeze the identity's emissions and route it to a willow-thin review queue—cheap to flag, costly to occupy.
